name: com.status403/site
title: status403
description: The status403 site as MCP tools: services, technical write-ups, and any page as markdown.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List the engineering services status403 offers — web scraping, reverse engineering, web3 and dApp engineering, and backend, frontend, and infrastructure engineering for new builds or existing systems — with what each one covers and the anchor link to its section on the page. Pass a query to keep only the services matching a keyword such as "scraping" or "anti-bot".

query.description: Optional keyword to filter by. Omit to list every service.

tools.name: answer_common_question
tools.description: Answer the questions clients ask status403 before booking — what the discovery call covers, how feasibility is assessed, what to prepare, whether delivery is production-ready or prototype, blocked and protected targets, and post-launch support. Also returns how a project runs, from first call to handoff. Pass a query to narrow it to the relevant answers.

query.description: Optional keyword, such as "support" or "feasibility". Omit for everything.

tools.name: search_blog
tools.description: Search the status403 technical write-ups on antibot systems, TLS fingerprinting, reverse engineering, scraping, and automation architecture. Returns matching posts with their title, date, tags, excerpt, and URL — pass a returned path to read_page for the full text. Omit the query to get the most recent posts.

query.description: Words to search for in titles, tags, excerpts, and post bodies.

limit.description: How many posts to return, most relevant first.

tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Read any page of status403 as markdown: "/" for the homepage (services, process, booking, FAQ), "/blog" for the post index, or "/blog/<slug>" for a post in full. This is the same document the site serves to clients that ask for it with `Accept: text/markdown`.

path.description: Site path, such as "/" or "/blog/<slug>". A full status403.com URL works too.
